digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V; Mgombato

teaser.en: The only plant the Digo identify by ear: listen for the wind whistling through its hollow thorns.
teaser.sw: Mmea pekee ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa sikio: sikiliza upepo ukipiga mluzi kupitia miiba yake yenye uwazi ndani.
teaser.dg: Mmea mwenga tu ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa kusikira: sikira phepho richipiga milozi kahi ya miyaye mihuphu.

summary.en: Muhega kululu is the coast whistling thorn, an acacia whose swollen, ant-hollowed thorns whistle in the wind. Pakia found it is the only plant the Digo identify by sound.
summary.sw: Muhega kululu ni *coast whistling thorn*, mgunga ambao miiba yake iliyovimba, iliyotobolewa na sisimizi, hupiga mluzi upepo unapovuma. Pakia aligundua kwamba ndio mmea pekee ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa sauti.
summary.dg: *Muhega kululu* ni *coast whistling thorn*, muhi wa miya wa jamii ya *acacia*, ambao miyaye iriyofutuka, iriyohendwa mihuphu ni sisimizi, inapiga milozi phepho richipiga. Pakia waona kukala ndio mmea mwenga tu ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa sauti.

about.en: Muhega kululu is a small, flat-topped thorn tree, usually 3 to 9 m tall, with feathery, finely divided leaves. Its long straight white thorns are paired, and some swell at the base into hollow, ball-like galls. Ants live in the galls and chew small holes in them, and when the wind blows across the holes they whistle. It has fluffy, round white flower heads and flat, curved pods.
about.sw: Muhega kululu ni mti mdogo wa miiba wenye kilele bapa, kwa kawaida wenye kimo cha mita 3 hadi 9, na majani laini kama manyoya yaliyogawanyika katika vijani vidogo. Miiba yake mirefu, iliyonyooka na myeupe iko jozi jozi, na baadhi huvimba kwenye kitako na kuwa vivimbe vyenye uwazi ndani kama mipira. Sisimizi huishi ndani ya vivimbe hivyo na kutafuna vitundu vidogo, na upepo unapovuma juu ya vitundu hivyo hupiga mluzi. Una vichwa vya maua meupe ya mviringo laini kama pamba, na maganda bapa yaliyopinda.
about.dg: *Muhega kululu* ni muhi mdide wa miya, wenye dzulu sawa-sawa, kpwa kawaida wa mita 3 hadi 9, na makodza ga manyoya ganagoganyika kukala makodza madide sana. Miyaye ni mire, mireru na ya kugoloka, na inamera mairi-mairi; yanjina inafutuka photsi ichikala dza mipira mihuphu. Sisimizi anakala mumo na anahenda makobo madide kpwa kuluma, na phepho richitsupa dzulu ya makobo higa, ganapiga milozi. Una vitswa vya maruwa vyereru vya mviringo, laini dza pamba, na makakaya mapana membamba ganagootyoka.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and wooded grassland, often on black-cotton or seasonally waterlogged clay soils, along the coast of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na nyika zenye miti za pwani, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wa mbuga (black cotton) au udongo wa mfinyanzi unaotuama maji kwa msimu, kando ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na nyasini phenye mihi pwani, mara nyinji kpwenye ulongo uriru au gandika inayodzala madzi wakati wa mvula, kanda-kanda ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: Pakia notes that hearing is not a method scientific botanists use to identify plants, but a Digo can identify this tree from the noise the wind makes in it, and it is the only species identified this way. Appendix V lists the wind sound, together with the leaves, as how it is recognised.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba kusikia si njia wanayoitumia wataalamu wa mimea kutambua mimea, lakini Mdigo anaweza kuutambua mti huu kwa sauti ya upepo ndani yake, na ndio spishi pekee inayotambuliwa kwa njia hii. Kiambatisho V kinaorodhesha sauti ya upepo, pamoja na majani, kama njia ya kuutambua.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala kusikira si njira inayohumirwa ni asayansi a mimea kumanya mimea, ela Mdigo anaweza kuumanya muhi uhu kpwa kululu phepho rinarohenda mwakpwe ndani, na ndiyo aina mwenga tu inayomanyikana hivyo. Nyongeza V inaandika kululu ra phepho, phamwenga na makodza, dza njira ya kuumanya.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Muhega kululu; Appendix V writes it Mpiga kululu. Pakia gives no meaning, but in Mgombato kululu means noise, which fits the tree's whistling. In English it is the coast whistling thorn; its scientific name is Acacia zanzibarica (now often Vachellia zanzibarica).
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Muhega kululu; Kiambatisho V kinaliandika Mpiga kululu. Pakia hatoi maana yake, lakini katika Mgombato kululu maana yake ni kelele, jambo linalolingana na mluzi wa mti huu. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coast whistling thorn*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Acacia zanzibarica (siku hizi mara nyingi Vachellia zanzibarica).
names.dg: Nyongeza III ya Pakia inapha *Muhega kululu*; Nyongeza V inaandika *Mpiga kululu*. Pakia kalavya mana, ela kpwenye Mgombato *kululu* ni 'noise' (kelele), na mana hino ni sawa na milozi ya muhi uhu. Kpwa Chingereza ni *coast whistling thorn*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Acacia zanzibarica* (sambi mara nyinji *Vachellia zanzibarica*).

reason.sw: Acacia seyal, mgunga mwingine unaopiga mluzi
reason.dg: *Acacia seyal*, muhi wanjina wa miya unaopiga milozi

reason.en: Another tree with kululu in its name
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wenye kululu katika jina lake
